indir.help_text: Directory with isolates assembleis to annotate in fasta formmat. This option is mutually exclusive with the --manifest option.

manifest.help_text: A two column headed csv manifest with ID,assembly columns. The assembly must contain the full paths to assemblies to be annotated. This option is mutually exclusive with the --indir option.

infile_extension.help_text: Only files in --indir ending with this string are used as input (e.g. '.fasta'). An empty string means every file in --indir is used.

bakta_db.help_text: Path to the Bakta database. If it doesn't exist under the given path, a database of the type set by --bakta_db_type is automatically downloaded. Defaults to bakta_db/db-light, or bakta_db/db when --bakta_db_type is 'full'.

bakta_db_type.help_text: Type of Bakta database to be downloaded. Note that pseudogene detection happens only with the 'full' database [light|full]

batch_size.help_text: This option changes the batch size as Pannotator runs by splitting the assemblies into batches in order to limit the numbers of files generated when running. It is worth noting that the default config has been setup with the default batch size in mind.

batch_of_batches_size.help_text: Select the number of batches to pass to each DETECT_PSEUDOGENES process when running the pipeline. As the number of batches_of_batches increases the memory requirements of DETECT_PSEUDOGENES will increase.

bundle_gff3.help_text: Bundle batches of gff3 into tar.gz bundles. Selecting false can result in large quantities of individual gff3 files when run on a large scale.

user_proteins.help_text: User-provided expert proteins in FASTA format for CDS annotation

user_hmms.help_text: User-provided hidden markov model in HMMER format for CDS annotation

compliant.help_text: Changes the final format of gff3 files to be compliant for ENA submission, '--compliant true' writes the compliant format while '--compliant false' produces full gff3 files in the final output.

auxiliary_db.help_text: Path to a pangenome index to save CDS annotations to. If an index already exists, it will be used to fetch protein annotations, bypassing the standard pipeline

extend_auxdb.help_text: Add CDS annotations to an existing pangenome JSON index

mmseqs_clusterPrefix.help_text: File from the mmseqs clustering are named with this prefix in the CLUSTER_SEQS process.

mmseqs_tmpDir.help_text: The name of the tmp directory passed to the CLUSTER_SEQS process

mmseqs_command.help_text: The clustering algorithm in mmseqs used to cluster protein sequences. The pipeline supports the use of 'easy-linclust' and 'easy-cluster'

mmseqs_clustering.help_text: Currently only strict is supported. The strict option triggers mmseqs protein clustering using a minimum sequence identity of 1.0 (exact matches). Not using the '--mmseqs_clustering strict' preset causes the pipeline to paramaterise mmseqs with the --mmseqs_min_seq_id, --mmseqs_cov_mode, --mmseqs_min_coverage, and --mmseqs_alignment_mode options.

mmseqs_min_seq_id.help_text: Minimum sequence identity (mmseqs --min-seq-id) for two proteins to cluster together. Only used when --mmseqs_clustering is not 'strict'.

mmseqs_min_coverage.help_text: Minimum alignment coverage (mmseqs -c). Only used when --mmseqs_clustering is not 'strict'.

mmseqs_cov_mode.help_text: Coverage mode (mmseqs --cov-mode). Only used when --mmseqs_clustering is not 'strict'.

mmseqs_alignment_mode.help_text: Alignment mode (mmseqs --alignment-mode). Only used when --mmseqs_clustering is not 'strict'.

mmseqs_args.help_text: Full argument string passed to the mmseqs clustering command. By default it is built from --mmseqs_clustering and the --mmseqs_* options above; setting it directly overrides those options.

monochrome_logs.help_text: Should logs appear in plain ASCII

scratch.help_text: Optionally utilise the nextflow scratch directive for the FIND_CDS, CLUSTER_SEQS, ANNOTATE_PROTEINS_MODULE, PARSE_BAKTA_JSON_ANNOTATIONS processes

rna_temp.help_text: The amount of temp space (MB) requested when submitting to LSF for the FIND_RNAS process. The default temp space is the recommended amount or the default batching configuration

cds_temp.help_text: The amount of temp space (MB) requested when submitting to LSF for the FIND_CDS process. The default temp space is the recommended amount or the default batching configuration

sorf_temp.help_text: The amount of temp space (MB) requested when submitting to LSF for the SORF_EXTRA process. The default temp space is the recommended amount or the default batching configuration

save_intermediate.help_text: The --save_intermediate option will retain individual pickle files, batched pickle files, and various intermediate files at various stages throughout the pipeline. It is primarlily used for debugging smaller batched runs of Pannotator. Enabling --save_intermediate can result in a VERY large numbers of files being retained and is not generally recommended.
